# Temple Scroll Column 22 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 22 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**22:1** You shall make a laver of copper with its stand of copper, for washing, and you shall place it between the tent of meeting and the altar.

**22:2** You shall fill it with water, and Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it.

**22:3** When they enter the tent of meeting, they shall wash with water so that they do not die, or when they approach the altar to minister, to offer a fire-offering to Me.

**22:4** They shall wash their hands and their feet so that they do not die. This shall be a perpetual statute for him and for his descendants throughout their generations.

**22:5** You shall make the courtyard of the tabernacle. On the south side, toward the Negev, there shall be hangings for the courtyard of finely twisted linen, one hundred cubits in length for that side.

**22:6** Its pillars shall number twenty, with twenty bases of copper; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-bands shall be of silver.

**22:7** Likewise for the north side: hangings of one hundred cubits in length, with twenty pillars and twenty bases of copper; the hooks of the pillars and their connecting-bands of silver.

**22:8** For the width of the courtyard on the west side: hangings of fifty cubits, with ten pillars and ten bases.

**22:9** For the width of the courtyard on the east side, toward the sunrise: fifty cubits.

**22:10** Fifteen cubits of hangings for one wing, with three pillars and three bases.

**22:11** And for the second wing, fifteen cubits of hangings, with three pillars and three bases.

**22:12** For the gate of the courtyard there shall be a screen of twenty cubits, of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn with finely twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer, with four pillars and four bases.

**22:13** All the pillars surrounding the courtyard shall be banded with silver, their hooks of silver, and their bases of copper.

**22:14** The length of the courtyard shall be one hundred cubits, the width fifty on each side, and the height five cubits, of finely twisted linen, with bases of copper.

**22:15** All the implements of the tabernacle for all its service, and all its stakes and all the stakes of the courtyard, shall be of copper.

**22:16** All of them shall be holy to Me, and they shall not profane them, for I, the LORD, dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 22 well preserved. Courtyard specifications parallel Exodus 27:9-19 with 30:17-21 (laver). "Wing" used for katef (lit. "shoulder") as an architectural term. "Connecting-bands" for chashukeihem, specifying the structural function.*
